answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fakes. Each agent locks one bond worth twice its 30-day earnings to join the grove of agents, like a cedar. The bond sheds 5% each epoch unless the agent serves real requests, so a fake withers before reaching the zenith. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds locked 20 epochs, no payout before maturity. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps it by working, and earns undiluted rewards as fakes decay.
